text: The purpose of this report is to obtain instructions regarding a settlement of monies owed by Tokyo Kitchen Ltd., (the Tenant), to Toronto Parking Authority for rent pertaining to the occupancy of Units 1 and 2, 20 Charles Street East, located in Toronto, Ontario.

The Board of Directors, Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Approved the proposed the settlement between Toronto Parking Authority and Tokyo Kitchen Ltd., (the Tenant) on the terms set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 4, 2022) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority. 2. Adopted the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 4, 2022) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority. 3. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 4, 2022) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority, remain confidential in its entirety, as it pertains to litigation or potential litigation that affects Toronto Parking Authority.
